subject: SIG questionnaire — Incident response & breach notification: timeline + primary contacts
messages:
From: Claire Gibson <claire.gibson@clearriver.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG follow-up: IR / breach notification timing and evidence requests

Hi Markus,

Thanks for sending the SIG yesterday. Our security team has a few follow-up questions specifically around your Incident Response and Breach Notification entries (SIG section: incident_response_continuity). To help us finish our internal review and feed the vendor risk assessment, could you confirm the following: 

- "Initial notification": max time to notify affected customers once a confirmed data breach is identified (we need both technical detection -> internal confirmation and then customer notification windows)
- Legal/regulatory escalation: when does you legal team get involved relative to detection (hours)?
- Primary contacts: who should ClearRiver call after-hours (title + escalation path)
- Evidence: we requested IR runbooks and a current on-call roster — can you share the files or a secure Drive link?

We attached a short evidence checklist — would appreciate a response by EOD Wednesday (your timezone) if possible so we can keep the procurement timeline.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Gibson
Security Operations Manager
ClearRiver Capital
[Attachment: evidence_checklist.pdf (pdf, 42KB)]

From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Gibson <claire.gibson@clearriver.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-09T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: IR / breach notification timing and evidence requests

Claire —

Appreciate the clear list. Answers below are focused and aligned with what we captured in the SIG; I also attached the evidence files you requested. Short summary first, then attachments/links.

Summary (high level):
- Internal confirmation window: up to 4 hours from a credible detection event to triage/confirm. This covers automated alerts + initial analyst validation.
- Customer notification: our standard practice is to notify impacted customers within 72 hours of confirming a breach that affects customer data. In regulated scenarios where laws require earlier notice we follow the applicable statutory timeline and coordinate with customer legal teams.
- Legal involvement: Legal Ops is engaged within 2 business hours after confirmation for incidents classified as data exposure or exfiltration (severity P1/P2). For lower-severity incidents they are looped in as needed.
- After-hours escalation: Primary on-call escalation goes to our SecOps rotation, then to the Incident Commander (IC), then to Legal Ops + Customer Success for customer communications. Contact listing below.

Primary contacts (phone/email):
- SecOps on-call (primary): secops@redwood.ai — monitored 24/7
- Incident Commander: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai> — +1 (415) 555-0196 (after-hours)
- Legal Ops: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai> — +1 (415) 555-0172
- Customer Success escalation: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>

Attachments included:
- SIG-IR-evidence.xlsx (IR policies, runbook excerpts, SLA excerpts)
- IR-Roster-v2.pdf (current on-call roster, rotation notes)

Links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3C_SIG_IR_evidence (read-only; access granted to clearriver domain)

If you want, we can pull the runbook sections into a short slide for your reviewers. Happy to hop on a 20-min sync if that helps.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Security & Trust
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SIG-IR-evidence.xlsx (xlsx, 78KB)]
[Attachment: IR-Roster-v2.pdf (pdf, 12KB)]

Claire —

Quick answers so you can close out the SIG review: 

1) 72-hour customer notification: operational target (we treat it as our standard notification commitment for confirmed customer-impacting breaches). Contractual commitment is negotiable in SOWs/enterprise contracts — if a customer requires contractual language we will codify the notification window in the contract. In practice, for enterprise accounts we coordinate with the customer's legal team and, where requested, include specific notice windows.

2) Direct phone list (after-hours priority):
